input.quote: f) IBM agrees that, for a period of [*] years from the Effective Date of this Agreement, it will not in any way solicit for employment any Transferred Employees without the prior written consent of MSL; provided, however, that the foregoing will not restrict or prevent IBM from a) employing any such person who contacts IBM on his or her own initiative without any solicitation or encouragement from IBM or b) by using general employment advertising or communications or independent search firms, hiring any person who responds thereto
input.rationale: Section 9.0(f) is the only solicitation restriction in the Agreement and it runs one way against us (IBM). Its scope and carve-outs already sit at or better than the fallback: it covers only the Transferred Employees (the personnel actually delivering the Products), it is a pure non-solicit with no no-hire (IBM may hire responders to general advertising or unsolicited contacts), and it carves out unsolicited approaches, general employment advertising/communications and independent search firms. The material term failing the fallback is duration: the restriction runs for "[*] years" from the Effective Date, a multi-year period beyond the 12 months our playbook permits (not walk-away unless the redacted figure exceeds 24 months). We therefore propose the minimal edit of resetting the period to twelve (12) months, leaving scope and carve-outs untouched, and flag an 18-month landing zone in the comment. MSL has no reciprocal covenant, but that absence does not burden us so we have not pressed it.

ops.oldText: for a period of [*] years from the Effective Date of this Agreement
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from the Effective Date of this Agreement

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We can accept this non-solicit only for a limited period, so we have set the restriction on IBM at twelve (12) months from the Effective Date; the existing multi-year term is longer than our policy permits. The narrow scope (Transferred Employees) and the unsolicited-approach and general-advertising carve-outs are acceptable as drafted, and we could live with an 18-month period if MSL needs more.
proposal.summary: Limit the non-solicit binding IBM to 12 months from the Effective Date.
